label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 152
title: Product page: Project Management tab (progress %, features+status, artifacts, quality summary, blockers, cost, activity)
body:
## Goal
The build-time view: overall progress % by phase; feature (F-x) table with status; artifacts by stage;
quality summary (gates/tests/evals); blockers; budget/cost actuals; activity + decisions; change requests.

## AC
- Derived from the backend read-model (BI-0216); no hand-maintained data.
- A non-media project renders correctly (empty media sections); progress % matches backend.
